system.title: System Settings
system.subtitle: System Settings
system.backendApiReadonlyAria: Backend API address (read-only, fixed at build time)
system.backendApiHint: Determined by the NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL environment variable at build time; not editable at runtime.
system.languageHint: Interface language. Changes apply immediately and are remembered.

account.title: Account
account.loggedIn: Signed in: authenticated operations such as data source management are now available.
account.provisioned: Accounts are provisioned by operators via {what} (public sign-up is off by default). Anonymous use is unaffected; write operations like data source management require signing in.

llm.title: Model configuration
llm.serverManaged: LLM settings are managed centrally on the server; saving here has no effect. Ask an administrator to change them server-side, then click "Refresh" to update.

rag.title: Knowledge base · RAG
rag.hintLocal: Display only: the backend currently uses a built-in local vector store (FAISS) and does not depend on an external vector database.
rag.hintDisplay: Display only: saving does not change backend retrieval behavior.
rag.docsNeedLogin: Sign in to view knowledge base documents
rag.docsLoadFailed: Failed to load knowledge base documents
rag.testNeedAdmin: Administrator permission is required to test the connection
rag.retrievalQueryPlaceholder: Enter a query to inspect retrieval hits and the score distribution…
rag.noHits: No hits — "{query}" matched nothing in the currently indexed documents.
rag.scoreDistAria: Hit score distribution: {count} hits, L2 distance range {min} to {max}
rag.scoreDistNote: Bar length is proportional to L2 distance (linear relative to the worst hit). A smaller L2 distance means more relevant — not a similarity percentage.
rag.embeddingNote: The embedding model is fixed by the backend (a code constant with no read/write config endpoint); this only probes retrieval quality.
rag.panelHint: Upload / delete documents and chat injection are done in the panel
